answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a bonding registry: each agent locks a non-refundable deposit tied to a unique hardware attestation before it may vote. The bond rests in a vault and is freed only when that identity permanently retires. Since there is one attestation per device, each Sybil needs a new device plus a fresh deposit, with no shortcut. A thousand fake votes cost a thousand bonds, while an honest agent pays once. Call the rule yarrow after the hardy plant: it survives because a sonnet of copied voices still pays for every line, so copying never gets cheaper.
